title: Take a one-block photo walk
summary: Walk one block and capture five photos around a single theme.
steps: Pick a theme like red, shadows, or reflections.
Walk one block without rushing.
Take five photos that match the theme.

title: Make a three-song walk playlist
summary: Choose three songs that make a short walk feel like a complete scene.
steps: Choose an opening, middle, and closing song.
Put them in order.
Save the playlist for your next walk.

title: Sketch one object from three angles
summary: Pick an ordinary object and draw three quick views without judging the result.
steps: Place one object in front of you.
Draw it from the front, side, and above.
Circle one detail you noticed.

title: Make a new phone wallpaper
summary: Turn a photo, color, or short phrase into a simple wallpaper you will enjoy seeing.
steps: Choose one photo or solid color.
Crop it to leave room for icons.
Set it as your wallpaper and check readability.

title: Write a postcard-length note
summary: Write a short, specific note to someone you appreciate and send it digitally or later by post.
steps: Pick one person.
Write three sentences about a shared memory or recent thought.
Send it or set it aside to post.

title: Photograph five things in one color
summary: Choose one color and find five different objects that carry it.
steps: Choose a color you can spot nearby.
Find five distinct examples.
Arrange the photos into a small album.

title: Pick a soundtrack for one room
summary: Choose music that fits one room and play it while you spend time there.
steps: Pick a room and the mood you want.
Choose four songs that fit.
Play them in that room without multitasking.

title: Do a ten-minute stair reset
summary: Use a safe staircase for a short up-and-down movement break at your own pace.
steps: Set a ten-minute timer.
Walk up and down at a controlled pace.
Slow down for the final minute.
safetyNote: Use a clear, well-lit staircase with a handrail and stop if you feel pain or dizzy.

title: Follow a five-minute stretch timer
summary: Move gently through a few comfortable stretches without trying to reach a target.
steps: Set a five-minute timer.
Stretch your shoulders, sides, and legs gently.
Finish with three easy breaths.
safetyNote: Stay within a pain-free range and avoid bouncing or forcing a stretch.

title: Walk until you take one new turn
summary: Start a familiar walk, then choose one safe turn you normally pass.
steps: Choose a familiar starting route.
Take one public, well-lit turn you have not tried.
Return by a route you recognize.
safetyNote: Stay on public paths, remain aware of traffic, and turn back if the route feels unsafe.

title: Dance through two songs
summary: Put on two songs and move however feels comfortable until both are finished.
steps: Clear a small area around you.
Choose two songs.
Keep moving until the second song ends.
safetyNote: Clear trip hazards and choose movements that suit your space and ability.

title: Try a quiet balance challenge
summary: Practice a few steady balance positions beside a stable support.
steps: Stand beside a stable support.
Balance on each foot for a comfortable count.
Repeat while looking at one fixed point.
safetyNote: Keep a stable support within reach and stop if you feel unsteady or dizzy.

title: Turn one errand into a loop walk
summary: Add a short walking loop before or after an errand you already need to do.
steps: Choose one nearby errand.
Plan a public loop that adds ten to fifteen minutes.
Complete the errand and walk the loop.
safetyNote: Use public routes, follow crossings, and carry only what you can manage comfortably.

title: Make a three-ingredient snack
summary: Combine three ingredients you already have into a simple snack with contrasting textures.
steps: Choose one base, one topping, and one contrast.
Assemble a small portion.
Taste and adjust once.
safetyNote: Check allergies, food freshness, and safe preparation temperatures before eating.

title: Cook from what you already have
summary: Build a simple meal around one pantry staple and one ingredient that needs using.
steps: Choose a staple such as rice, pasta, or beans.
Add one ingredient that needs using.
Cook a small, simple meal and note what worked.
safetyNote: Use clean equipment and follow safe handling and cooking guidance for all ingredients.

title: Make a tiny tea tasting
summary: Brew two teas or two strengths of one tea and compare aroma, color, and taste.
steps: Choose two teas or two brew times.
Brew small servings.
Compare aroma, color, and flavor.
safetyNote: Handle boiling water carefully and let drinks cool before tasting.

title: Invent a new toast topping
summary: Use one familiar ingredient and one unexpected ingredient to make a small toast combination.
steps: Pick one familiar and one contrasting topping.
Toast the bread safely.
Assemble, taste, and name the combination.
safetyNote: Use the toaster and any knives safely, and check ingredients for allergies.

title: Buy one unfamiliar ingredient
summary: Choose one affordable ingredient you have not cooked with and learn one simple use for it.
steps: Browse one nearby food shop.
Choose an affordable unfamiliar ingredient.
Read its label and find one simple preparation method.
safetyNote: Check allergens, storage guidance, and preparation requirements before using the ingredient.

title: Learn one cooking technique
summary: Practice one basic technique such as folding, whisking, or chopping with a simple ingredient.
steps: Choose one technique and read a trusted explanation.
Prepare a clear work area.
Practice slowly with one ingredient.
safetyNote: Use heat and sharp tools only with suitable equipment and follow established kitchen safety guidance.

title: Reset one drawer
summary: Empty, sort, and return only the useful contents of one small drawer.
steps: Choose one small drawer.
Remove everything and discard obvious rubbish.
Group and return the items you use.

title: Rearrange one shelf
summary: Change the order or grouping on one shelf to make it easier or nicer to use.
steps: Choose one shelf.
Remove a few items and wipe the surface.
Return items in a more useful grouping.

title: Tidy one cable tangle
summary: Identify, separate, and loosely bundle one small group of cables.
steps: Unplug devices safely if needed.
Remove unused cables.
Route and loosely secure the remaining cables.
safetyNote: Disconnect power before moving electrical cables and never use damaged cords.

title: Refresh the entryway
summary: Reset the first area you see at home by clearing shoes, bags, and loose items.
steps: Clear anything that belongs elsewhere.
Group daily shoes and bags.
Wipe one visible surface.

title: Start a laundry sprint
summary: Gather one manageable load and get it washing or sorted within fifteen minutes.
steps: Set a fifteen-minute timer.
Gather and sort one load.
Start the wash or place the sorted load ready to run.

title: Change the room lighting
summary: Adjust one room using the lights and window coverings you already have.
steps: Choose the room mood you want.
Turn off unnecessary overhead lights.
Adjust a lamp or window covering and sit with the result.

title: Learn a board game opening move
summary: Pick a game you own and learn one useful first-turn idea from its rules or guide.
steps: Choose one game.
Read its setup and first-turn options.
Practice one opening move twice.

title: Learn five phrases in a language
summary: Choose five practical phrases and practice saying each one clearly.
steps: Choose a situation such as greeting or ordering food.
Write down five phrases.
Say each phrase three times.

title: Study your neighborhood map
summary: Look at a map and find three public places or routes you have not noticed before.
steps: Center the map on your neighborhood.
Find three public places or paths.
Save one for a future walk without sharing your location.

title: Watch one short documentary clip
summary: Choose a focused documentary segment, watch without scrolling, and note one fact.
steps: Choose a topic you know little about.
Watch one short segment without multitasking.
Write down one fact to remember.

title: Learn one phone shortcut
summary: Find one built-in phone shortcut that removes a repeated step from your day.
steps: Pick one repeated phone task.
Check the built-in settings or help for a shortcut.
Try it twice and keep it only if useful.

title: Read about one museum object
summary: Choose one digitized museum object and spend fifteen minutes learning its story.
steps: Choose one object that catches your eye.
Read its description and context.
Summarize its story in one sentence.

title: Send a specific check-in text
summary: Message one person with a concrete question that is easy to answer.
steps: Choose someone you genuinely want to hear from.
Ask one specific, low-pressure question.
Send it without expecting an immediate reply.

title: Invite someone for a short coffee
summary: Offer one person a specific, low-pressure time window for coffee or tea.
steps: Choose one person and a realistic day.
Suggest a short time window and simple place.
Send the invitation with room for them to decline.

title: Trade three songs with someone
summary: Exchange three songs with a friend and include one line about each choice.
steps: Pick three songs for one person.
Add a short reason for each.
Send them and invite three songs back.

title: Take a question walk
summary: Take a short walk together and each bring two questions you have not asked before.
steps: Choose a familiar public route.
Each person brings two considerate questions.
Walk and take turns answering.
safetyNote: Use a public, well-lit route and stay aware of crossings and surroundings.

title: Run a group snack poll
summary: Ask a small group to choose between three simple snack options for the next meetup.
steps: Choose three realistic snack options.
Post a simple poll.
Use the result for the next planned meetup.

title: Keep a ten-minute cloud log
summary: Watch the sky from a safe spot and record how the clouds change over ten minutes.
steps: Choose a safe place with a clear view.
Note the cloud shapes and movement.
Record one change after ten minutes.
safetyNote: Use a safe public or private spot and protect yourself from strong sun or severe weather.

title: Read on a nearby bench
summary: Take something short to read and finish a few pages on a public bench.
steps: Choose a familiar public bench.
Bring a short reading.
Read without checking notifications for twenty minutes.
safetyNote: Choose a safe public place, stay aware of belongings, and avoid severe weather.

title: Find three different trees
summary: Walk a familiar public route and notice three trees with clearly different leaves or bark.
steps: Choose a public walking route.
Find three visibly different trees.
Photograph or describe one detail from each.
safetyNote: Stay on public paths, do not climb or damage trees, and remain aware of traffic.

title: Walk to a sunset spot
summary: Choose a familiar public viewpoint and arrive early enough to watch the light change.
steps: Check sunset time before leaving.
Choose a familiar public spot.
Leave while there is enough daylight to return safely.
safetyNote: Use a well-lit public route, avoid isolated areas, and return before visibility becomes poor.

title: Find the nearest water view
summary: Use a map to choose a safe public view of a river, pond, sea, or fountain and walk there.
steps: Find a public water view on a map.
Choose a familiar, accessible route.
Spend five minutes observing before returning.
safetyNote: Stay behind barriers, avoid entering water, and use public routes suitable for current weather.

title: Do a window breathing reset
summary: Stand or sit by a window and take five slow, comfortable breaths while noticing the view.
steps: Choose a comfortable spot by a window.
Notice three things outside.
Take five slow breaths without forcing the pace.

title: Delete ten old screenshots
summary: Review only your screenshots and remove ten that no longer help you.
steps: Open the screenshots album.
Delete ten images you no longer need.
Stop after ten instead of expanding the task.

title: Do a five-sense reset
summary: Pause and name one ordinary thing you can notice through each sense.
steps: Sit or stand somewhere comfortable.
Name one thing you see, hear, feel, smell, and taste.
Choose one sensation to notice for another minute.

title: Take a twenty-minute timer nap
summary: Set a short alarm, make the room comfortable, and rest without trying to force sleep.
steps: Set an alarm for twenty minutes.
Put the phone out of reach and get comfortable.
Rest quietly until the alarm, even if you do not sleep.

title: Clear one visible surface
summary: Pick one small visible surface and return it to a clean, useful state.
steps: Choose one table, counter section, or desk corner.
Return misplaced items.
Wipe the cleared surface and stop there.

title: Build a micro movie night
summary: Choose one short film or a single episode and make a deliberate mini screening at home.
steps: Choose one title before sitting down.
Dim the room and put the phone away.
Watch it from start to finish.

title: Listen to an album without scrolling
summary: Play one album from the beginning and give it your full attention for the first few tracks.
steps: Choose an album you have not heard fully.
Put the phone face down after starting it.
Listen through and save one favorite track.

title: Play one round of a retro game
summary: Choose an older game you already have access to and play one contained round or level.
steps: Choose one familiar older game.
Set a twenty-minute limit.
Play one round or level and stop at the next save point.

title: Pick a random library item
summary: Browse one library shelf or your borrowed collection and choose something outside your usual category.
steps: Choose a shelf or digital category you rarely use.
Pick one item based on its first page or description.
Read, watch, or listen for fifteen minutes before deciding whether to continue.
